description:
# Smart Context Window Optimization

Intelligent context window management that prioritizes relevant code, removes redundant information, and dynamically adjusts context based on task complexity. Uses semantic similarity to rank and select most relevant files for large codebases.

## Rationale
Addresses pain point: 'Context window bottleneck - enterprise monorepos exceed LLM context limits'. Critical for large codebases. Competitors analyze only ~10% of files fabricating 60% of details. This is a key differentiator for enterprise users with monorepos.

## User Stories
- As a developer, I want AI to focus on relevant files, not waste context on unrelated code
- As a user with a large monorepo, I want AI to work within context limits without fabricating details
- As a developer, I want to understand why certain files were included/excluded from context

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Semantic relevance scoring ranks files by importance to task
- [ ] Redundant code detection removes duplicate context
- [ ] Context window usage displayed in real-time with warnings
- [ ] Dynamic context adjustment based on task complexity
- [ ] Context compression for large files (summaries, key sections)
- [ ] User can override context selection with file priority hints
- [ ] Context selection reasoning exposed to user for transparency
